title: STAR RIOT
description: Disco fever. Future sounds. Zero ordinary nights. Step into the place where the dance floor becomes the whole universe.

sections.title: Header & Brand Navigation
sections.summary: Custom split neon star glyph, primary links (`NIGHTS`, `THE SPACE`, `THE SOUND`, `FAQ`), mobile drawer.

sections.title: Hero Section (The Ignition)
sections.summary: Giant display type `TONIGHT, WE GO SUPERNOVA.`, live DJ lineup deck with BPM selector, interactive equalizer bars with transport controls, tonight set slots, colossal neon star portal, and vector disco dancers.

sections.title: Manifesto Section
sections.summary: `ORDINARY NIGHTS? NOT HERE.`, 3 core club pillars, spinning vinyl record, and animated ticker marquee.

sections.title: Nights Section (Pick Your Frequency)
sections.summary: Frequency filter tabs (`All`, `House & Edits`, `Classic Disco`, `Soul & Boogie`), 3 poster cards with 3D pointer tilt, accessible event detail dialog modal with lineup breakdown.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Sound Stage Section (The Sound Takes Over)
sections.summary: Scroll-controlled 3-stage progression (`01. WARM UP` → `02. TURN UP` → `03. ALL OUT`) with expanding bass rings, erupting supernova star, and live telemetry readout.

sections.title: Space Section (The Space)
sections.summary: 4-zone architectural collage featuring sunken sprung floor with real-time under-floor lighting matrix switcher, triple mirror-ball orbit, 360° floor-level booth, and hospitality crew.

sections.title: Movement Section (Voices From The 3 AM Floor)
sections.summary: Sticker photo-wall snap carousel with interactive peel note flips, plus FAQ accordion.

sections.title: Guestlist Conversion Section
sections.summary: Priority floor access form with real-time validation, deterministic demo pass code generation (`SR-XXXX-YYY`), barcode graphic, and live RSVP counter.

sections.title: Site Footer
sections.summary: Brand sign-off, quick links, fictional concept disclaimer, back-to-top control.
